title: onboard-ceres-20b-v1.0-perf-profiles-and-changelog-automation
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Onboard Ceres 20B v1.0 to the model registry with initial performance profiles and automated changelog generation. This release adds metadata, perf profiles, and release-note automation to ensure consistent onboarding for future models.
description: Motivation: Add Ceres-20B v1.0 to the registry with validated performance profiles and automate changelog/release note generation to reduce manual bookkeeping. Scope: model metadata and manifest, baseline latency/throughput perf profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, integration tests for profile validation, and a small automation hook that appends a changelog entry when a model is published. Changes include metadata JSON for the model, perf profile YAMLs for cpu/gpu/quantized variants, a validation script that runs CI-time smoke perf checks against a gated test infra, updates to the registry index, and the changelog automation that aggregates profile deltas into the release notes. Testing: local unit tests for metadata schema validation, CI perf smoke checks (mocked), end-to-end onboarding dry-run against staging, and manual spot-checks on dedicated infra. Rollout plan: merge to main, run the registry publish pipeline with staging flag, validate perf numbers and artifact availability, then flip publish flag to make model visible in catalog. Rollback: remove registry index entry and revert main; artifacts are stored in the artifact bucket and versioned, so full rollback is possible. Related work: ENG-4821 (model onboarding framework), PM-210 (catalog UX).
commits: 1) Add model metadata and manifest (models/ceres/20b/v1.0/metadata.json) 2) Add perf profiles (models/ceres/20b/v1.0/perf/profiles_gpu.yaml, profiles_cpu.yaml, profiles_quant.yaml) 3) Add changelog automation hook and CLI integration (tools/changelog/generate_release_notes.py) 4) Add CI perf smoke test (ci/perf/ceres_smoke_test.yml) 5) Tests and docs updates (docs/models/ceres.md)
files_changed: models/ceres/20b/v1.0/metadata.json - new model metadata including architectures, tokenizer, download URLs, checksums, recommended quantization and default config
models/ceres/20b/v1.0/perf/profiles_gpu.yaml - gpu latency/throughput profiles (sequences: 64/128/512, batch sizes: 1/4/8), measured on p4d and a100
models/ceres/20b/v1.0/perf/profiles_cpu.yaml - CPU baseline profiles for benchmarking and fallback routing
models/ceres/20b/v1.0/perf/profiles_quant.yaml - int8/4-bit quantized perf projections and notes
tools/changelog/generate_release_notes.py - automation script that reads perf profile diffs and appends a standardized changelog entry
ci/perf/ceres_smoke_test.yml - CI job to run a small perf smoke check against staging infra (gated) before publish
docs/models/ceres.md - user-facing quickstart and perf guidance
review_comments: Mateo Alvarez: Quick nit on the metadata schema: can we include 'supported_tokenizers' as a top-level array to be explicit? Also request more context on quantized accuracy expectations.

Priya Desai (author): Good call on supported_tokenizers — added 'sentencepiece' and 'byte-level-bpe' to the metadata and clarified quantized accuracy expectations in the perf notes. Quant accuracy was measured in-house on the validation set; numbers are included in the profiles with a note.
Connor Li: CI perf smoke looks good but the gating threshold is tight for p4d; suggest allowing +10% slack for the first published profile to avoid false negatives during initial rollout.
Priya Desai (author): Updated smoke test thresholds to include a 10% slack parameter controlled by CI variable 'SMOKE_SLACK_PERCENT'. Documented expected behavior in ci/perf/ceres_smoke_test.yml.
Jingwei Zhao: Can the changelog automation include a composed 'perf delta' section comparing the new model to the default family (e.g., aura-16b) so product can display concise upgrade guidance?

Priya Desai (author): Added perf delta generation in generate_release_notes.py which computes percent differences against a baseline family when baseline profiles are present. The generated changelog entry includes a small table and a human-readable summary.
ci_checks: integration - pass (registry index dry-run on staging)
perf-smoke - pass (gated, ran on p4d-staging with SMOKE_SLACK_PERCENT=10)
release-note-generation - pass (automation script produced expected markdown snippet)
notes_on_merge: Squashed and merged after reviewers approved and CI green. Changelog automation triggered a draft release note which was reviewed by PM before publishing.
perf_profiles_summary: GPU (a100): seq64 b1=45ms, seq128 b1=78ms, seq512 b1=320ms; p4d similar within 10%. CPU baselines provided for small batch scenarios. Quantized int8 shows ~1.8x throughput improvement with ~2-3% accuracy drop on validation.
upgrade_instructions: Publish pipeline: run tools/changelog/generate_release_notes.py --model ceres/20b/v1.0 --staging then run registry publish job with staging flag. After verification flip 'published=true' in registry index. See docs/models/ceres.md for recommended routing policies and quantization notes.
manual_test_notes: Manual spot checks performed on dedicated infra: token-level latency histograms, KV cache warm/cold checks, and sample end-to-end chat calls. No regression observed compared to expected baselines.
